sections.heading: Learning Point 16
sections.content: The Glorious Hampi Bazaar, Karnataka The Hampi Bazaar in Karnataka was one of the prosperous markets in the Vijayanagara Empire which was the centre of flourishing trade.

sections.heading: Learning Point 19
sections.content: The famous Portuguese traveller, Domingos Paes, called Hampi “the best-provided city in the world” due to the wide variety of products traded in the market— grains, seeds, milk, oil, silk, animals like cows, rabbits, horses, and even birds like quails and partridges.
